original_manifest_entry.accessible_description: Two crossed brass sluice blades rise behind a broken lockgate mast, snapped oath-chain, bargebow rest, and twin ember braziers.
A forked bog-antler arch carries three mossglass hound masks, hooked chains, bone charms, and a central reed lantern.
Two curved ivory mirror forks surround a suspended faceted prism chime, angled reflector vanes, and a low bronze resonant bowl.
Two bent living trunks form a walking-root arch carrying three graft baskets, a thorn bell, ram plate, red cloth, and pale fungi.
A tall riveted seizure gauge carries an off-center brass wheel, hanging counterweight, twin red pavises, rivet hopper, and caged lamp.
Salt-worn skiff ribs arch around a suspended sea bell, two mourning lanterns, torn fog pennant, wet rope, and a long undertow harpoon.
A barnacled toll chest rests beneath a broken ship-rib arch with drowned ledgers and a hanging bronze bell.
A faceted crystal censor cage locks around a mud-caked reliquary with angular lens vanes and snapped chain seals.
A red pressure gauge dominates an iron survey barricade fitted with needle calipers and broken mirror shards.
A squat hide war drum is swallowed by thorn roots, crossed crook sticks, glowing seed pods, and damp rope.
An iron railhead ends at a fortified lockgate beneath a burning wax charter seal and hooked brass counterweight.
A living root bollard twists around a wrecked mast, taut ghost rope, torn sail hook, and pale mist lantern.
A timber tally frame straddles a peat sump beneath a looped iron chain, brass counting plate, and crooked bog stakes.
A tall blue prism hangs in an angular gold impound above a short rail and paired chain winches.
A compact wheeled furnace glows behind crossed rail beams, riveted plates, a crooked stack, and thorn-bound wheels.
A cracked salt-dark bell hangs inside a pale root arch with shells, orchard limbs, and one violet ghost lantern.
A black anchor buoy carries a burning cage lantern, taut lock chain, hooked counterweight, and scorched pennon.
A pale broken ship mast grows through a forked root shrine with ghost sail ribbons, seed cages, and a low tide bell.
A round woven reed hive hangs above a bog cradle, locked by a heavy brass chain, counting clamp, and wax seals.
Two blackened reed pillars form a forked arch around a hanging votive charm, caged ember, and ferry-knot ropes.
Three tilted blue mirrors ride a bone-white ship-rib carriage above hooked rails and a salt-dark bell counterweight.
A tall brass tripod carries a circular blue survey lens gripped by living roots, side vanes, seed cages, and glass markers.
A hooked black driftwood mast rises from a curved keel brace with dark sail ribbons, a memorial bell, and one violet fog lantern.
A tall three-legged reed and bone cradle suspends an amber sun prism above a mirrored basin between three radial glass fins.
A broad circular pressure gauge is half covered by a black crescent shutter between two short furnace stacks and curved copper pipes.
Three living root arms curl around a split stone brazier with green graft buds, a disciplined white flame, and a bronze charter clasp.
Three crooked antler-capped bogwood stakes form a triangle around hanging brass tally plates, a wax seal, and a green basin.
A broad living-root arch frames a pale seed crown, crossed by a curved fogglass keel blade, dark chain, and silver mist bells.
A domed brick kiln sits behind a short mallet barricade beneath two copper-capped vents and paired ember-pot hoists.
A squat timber toll lodge anchors a long hooked pike gate beside a stone chimney, covered bow rack, and chained yard.
Twin narrow cliff spires carry sheltered slinger nests, rope bridges, a central wind perch, and hooked architectural finials.
A circular living coppice palisade surrounds a raised leaf-roofed platform between two tall sapwhistle horn posts.
Overlapping black-glass shield slabs ring a low fissure trench between two compact ash-dart rack towers.
A steep-roofed wharf house stands on short frozen pilings beside a crescent pier, cutter cradle, and paired throwing racks.
Two hooked-roof kennel sheds flank a fenced training ring beneath a raised bell post and stacked oval shields.
Three broad mushroom caps shelter a stone cellar croft, guarded entry stair, drying frames, and a hanging spore-lamp gantry.
A split stone spire carries a compact signal cabin, two broad angular kite frames, a wind-vane crown, and zigzag rope stairs.
Twin orchard trunks arch around a leaf-roof levy pavilion, round millstone platform, upright polearm racks, and harvest baskets.
A tall faceted milestone rises through a low riveted armory between paired cartbow racks, shield stacks, and an iron awning.
A steep-roof pilot house stands on short pilings beneath a flare mast, crescent lookout balcony, crossed mooring poles, and rope winch.
Twin reed barges are chained beneath a long diagonal boom gate beside a roofed ledger booth and forked lantern mast.
A crooked salvage wind scoop towers above a riveted scrap shed, uneven vanes, narrow lookout gantry, and crescent plate wall.
A steep-roof stone bothy supports a tall forked crystal beacon and round signal mirror between two short snowbreak palisades.
Three stacked hostel levels climb around a zigzag exterior stair toward a pack-sled arch and tall cairn signal post.
Six shallow salt trays fan around a striped shade mast, brine wheel, low round-shield barricade, and tally shelter.
A ringed stone sump holds clustered crystals beneath a crooked echo-horn lifting frame and two offset low guard walls.
Three glowing charcoal clamps rise beneath a crooked smoke hood beside a timber fire cage and hanging iron mallets.
An oversized bronze marsh bell hangs above a stilted reed croft, curved plank approach, peat jars, and bundled rushes.
Two enormous antler hook cranes arch over a steep snow lodge with net racks, blue iceglass lamps, and a narrow porch.
A broad stone burrow arch glows beneath two crooked lantern towers, brass needle rails, and pale mushroom-glass caps.
A towering brass stamping arm crowns a three-wheeled mobile writ press loaded with chained scrip drums and sealed canisters.
A tilted meridian ring circles a narrow bell beacon above a dark skiff prow, blue-white lenses, and a misaligned compass needle.
